title: Climbing Stairs
hints: Your last move onto step `n` was either a 1-step or a 2-step. Where were you just before it?
ways(n) = ways(n - 1) + ways(n - 2), with ways(1) = 1 and ways(2) = 2. Build the answer upwards with two variables instead of recursion.
The Fibonacci numbers follow the same rule: each is the sum of the previous two, and a loop computes them in linear time.
